# APEX PSI — Proof of Stateful Integrity

> Open-standard cryptographic evidence protocol for AI governance. Records the
> existence and integrity of a decision, document or artefact at a point in
> time. It does not judge whether the contents are true.

Canonical site: https://ai-governance-standard.com

## Connect an AI agent (MCP)
npx -y apex-psi-mcp
- Server manifest: https://ai-governance-standard.com/.well-known/mcp/server.json
- OAuth metadata: https://ai-governance-standard.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- Tools: verify_hash, list_attestations, ledger_stats, protocol_info

## Core pages
- /protocol — protocol specification
- /spec — EU AI Act Article 50 mapping
- /standard — Compliance-Receipt HTTP header
- /verify — public hash verification
- /pramaan — human witness sealing
- /api — REST API reference
- /integrations — integration surfaces
- /ledger — company recomputation ledger
- /partners — verified, integrated and powered-by programmes

## Standards
RFC 8785 (JCS), SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), Ed25519 (RFC 8032), ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204),
LMS-W4-SHA256 (NIST SP 800-208), draft-singh-psi-00, draft-singh-psi-http-01.

## Trust anchor
https://ai-governance-standard.com/.well-known/apex-psi-trust-anchor.json
